evidence: Has long rejected single-payer Medicare for All, routinely criticizing it and backing a Medicare buy-in and ACA fixes instead (PolitiFact, Sep 2018).
Cosponsor, Protecting Health Care and Lowering Costs Act, S.2556 (Jul 2025), which would reverse the OBBBA's health care cuts including Medicaid.
Cosponsor, Improving Seniors' Timely Access to Care Act of 2025, S.1816 (joined Dec 2025).
Original cosponsor, American Family Act, S.1393 (Apr 2025), expanding the Child Tax Credit and making it fully refundable.
Cosponsor, Child Care for Working Families Act, S.2295 (joined Sep 2025), which caps family child care costs at 7% of income.
2026 platform calls for replacing the immigration system with a comprehensive one, a clear pathway to citizenship, and a secure border.
2026 platform criticizes broad tariffs but backs targeted, sunsetting tariffs for Michigan manufacturing; no stance on the emergency tariffs or Trade Review Act.
2026 platform calls for a federally funded housing building boom and streamlined local rules; related to, not an endorsement of, the ROAD to Housing Act.
Cosponsor, Cruz's S.J.Res.1 constitutional amendment limiting congressional terms (Jan 2025).
Sponsor, Faster Labor Contracts Act, S.844 (Mar 2025), forcing quick first-contract bargaining and arbitration; narrower than the PRO Act, which he has not cosponsored.
Sponsor, GUARD Act, S.3062, on AI chatbots and minors (2025); also cosponsor of the AI LEAD Act, S.2937, creating AI product liability (Sep 2025).
